panels.title: Collector uptime (seconds)
panels.description: otelcol_process_uptime -- the Collector's own self-telemetry, present from the moment it starts, independent of any service being instrumented (Task 11.2).

panels.title: Collector process memory (RSS)
panels.description: otelcol_process_memory_rss -- self-telemetry, live from the moment the Collector starts. otelcol_exporter_sent_* / otelcol_receiver_accepted_* only appear once a pipeline carries real traffic, which starts with Task 11.2's instrumentation -- not plotted here to avoid a panel that reads as broken until then.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Every static_configs target in prometheus.yml -- 2 as of Task 11.1 (the Collector's self-telemetry port and its app fan-out port), both up regardless of service instrumentation.
